attrib.descriptionVerbose: Canvas view configuration carried over from the source SVG.
attrib.notes: All attributes and structure preserved exactly from original SVG; enrichment adds documentation fields only.

descriptionVerbose: namedview element capturing the Inkscape view/canvas settings for this document.
notes: This namedview node stores canvas properties from the original drawing. Geometry and raw attributes are taken directly from the source SVG; only descriptive metadata (descriptionVerbose, notes, category, role, shapeType, aria-label) has been added to make the element self-explanatory for downstream tools or viewers.
